name: mirage
text: Read the screenshot and the engine's own timing. Why the odds are old: the last scan took 795 s because it reads 10,427 Novig books at about 13 a second (2,120 by the live feed, 8,307 through the key), and the fair odds are read once in the first 84 s. For games starting within 12 h the engine re-asks only the free and flat-rate feeds every 45 s (154 re-reads that scan); the paid-by-credit feeds, ParlayAPI and PropLine, were never re-asked, so the other books' prices behind a bet were 10-18 min old and 24 of your 33 bets were held back as 'prices too old'. Fix in the next release (v1.0.27, building now): with a paid ParlayAPI key (your Pro) it joins the hot refresh and is re-read for the games about to start every 2.5 min, inside its credit pace. The bigger lever is the 13-minute full scan itself (laned scans so near games are read first and far games less often); that is the largest remaining job on this problem and I am taking it next.
